title: The Pythian Temple and his father's lodge
summary: Asked about dances at the Pythian, he says he was too young but his father belonged to the Knights of Pythias and Odd Fellows.

Did you ever go to any dances or anything at the Petian?

I wasn't old enough. I knew my daddy went there to pay a bill one day because my daddy was a member of the Knights of the Petian and also was a member of the Oddfellas Club. So that's my the only experience I had with him you know but it's going back a long time ago but I remember the place I never went there for any entertainment. Now whether Louis I think Louis Armstrong made one appearance there but what year he did I really don't know I have a whole rack of history on Louis Armstrong.
